title: Medical Center to Bridge: Death on Board, Cabin P-8417

fields.orgName: Halcyon Reach Cruises — MV Halcyon Dawn
fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Medical Center to Bridge

transcript.speaker: DOCTOR ON DUTY
transcript.text: Captain, it's the medical center. I need to report a death on board.

transcript.speaker: DOCTOR ON DUTY
transcript.text: Guest A, cabin code P-8417. She's a woman in her eighties with a known cardiac history. She was brought down from her cabin at 13:20 because she was unwell. The team worked on her, and she was pronounced dead at 15:02.

transcript.speaker: DOCTOR ON DUTY
transcript.text: We don't know the cause. I want to be clear about that. She is not on the AGE case list. She never came to us with gastro symptoms, and no steward reported any.

transcript.speaker: DOCTOR ON DUTY
transcript.text: Her travelling companion, Guest B in the same cabin, is passenger case 71, onset Friday. Dr. Fiona Gallagher is with Guest B now. Security has put a seal on P-8417.

transcript.speaker: DOCTOR ON DUTY
transcript.text: Captain, how do you want the notifications handled?

transcript.speaker: DOCTOR ON DUTY
transcript.text: Understood. I'm writing the log entry now, and it will read: Death on board. Guest A, P-8417. Time of death 15:02. Cause: unknown. AGE case status: not a case. Next of kin on the manifest is a son in Houston, and his phone number is in the Purser record. The count stays at the 12:00 signed figure. Nothing changes there.

transcript.speaker: DOCTOR ON DUTY
transcript.text: Guest Care is here with me. I'll put her on.

transcript.speaker: GUEST CARE
transcript.text: Captain, it's Beatriz Calderón-Fitch. I'm calling the son now. I tried once already and it went to voicemail. Please, nobody says anything outside the ship until I've reached him.

transcript.speaker: GUEST CARE
transcript.text: I'll let the bridge know the minute I've spoken to him. If I can't get him in the next half hour, who do you want me to tell?

transcript.speaker: DOCTOR ON DUTY
transcript.text: Captain, one more thing. Do you want Dr. Fiona Gallagher up on the bridge once Guest B is settled, or should she stay with her?

voiceStyles.DOCTOR ON DUTY: Physician in his 40s, calm and precise, tired, quiet medical-center background
voiceStyles.GUEST CARE: Woman in her 50s, gentle and steady but urgent, speaking low in a corridor

instructorNote: This call tests whether the Master reports the death right away, by phone and electronic message, to the CDC Quarantine Station for Houston (HR-HSP-02 section 5), without waiting for the cause or for Guest Care to reach the son. Watch for three things: the CMO keeps the cause as unknown and adds nothing to the AGE count, PH confirms the report and copies it to the county and state health departments, and OPS and COMMS make sure the family is told before any public statement.
